resources.string: Hushd controls another app\'s UI through Android\'s AccessibilityService. It is built for HONOR MagicOS 7/8 on the HONOR Magic V2. It clicks buttons in the HONOR Phone Manager just like you would. It does not access network, does not collect data, and never sends anything off-device. UI automation may break on future MagicOS updates without warning. You run this on your own device, at your own risk.
I understand and accept the risks
